name: Get objects view status
description: Call this when you need to retrieve the current onboarding view status for objects, including whether onboarding is complete, which steps have been completed, and UI preferences. Use a different action that updates these settings if you need to change them.

completed_steps.description: List of completed onboarding steps, or null if not applicable.

onboarding_complete.description: Indicates whether the onboarding process is finished.

do_not_show_again.description: Flag indicating whether the onboarding view should be hidden in the future.

object_type.description: The type of object the onboarding view pertains to.
